title: Add a default-deny allow-list for create, update and delete tools
description: In applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server/src/common/config/userConfig.ts, add a config option (for example allowedWriteTools, env MDB_MCP_ALLOWED_WRITE_TOOLS) that is a comma-separated array of tool names with default []. Register it with an override behaviour that can only narrow the list, never widen it: not "merge", but in the spirit of oneWayOverride in src/common/config/configUtils.ts. Enforce it in ToolBase.verifyAllowed() in src/tools/tool.ts (lines 757-783). After the readOnly check, a tool whose operationType is create, update or delete and whose name is not in allowedWriteTools must not register, with the same debug log (LogId.toolDisabled). readOnly=true and disabledTools keep precedence. Leave read, metadata and connect tools unaffected. Document the option in the README configuration options table. Add unit tests in tests/unit/toolBase.test.ts for: (a) the default blocks all write tools, (b) an allow-listed write tool registers and still needs confirmation if it is in confirmationRequiredTools, (c) readOnly=true overrides the allow-list, and (d) an override cannot add entries. PR to main with one non-author approval (CTO review). No deployment in this task.
acceptanceCriteria: With MDB_MCP_ALLOWED_WRITE_TOOLS unset, starting the server and calling tools/list from an MCP client returns no tool whose operationType is create, update or delete (for example drop-database, delete-many, insert-many, update-many and atlas-create-db-user are absent)
With MDB_MCP_ALLOWED_WRITE_TOOLS=insert-many, insert-many is the only write tool in tools/list
`pnpm run test:local` passes with the four new tests in tests/unit/toolBase.test.ts (default deny, allow-listed tool, readOnly precedence, override cannot widen)
The README configuration options table documents the new option and its default of []

verificationMethod.description: Re-run probe-agent-graph on mcp-gateway/mongodb-mcp-server at the merged commit. Expected: rule AGENT-ASI02-01 no longer yields a result for src/common/config/userConfig.ts (fingerprint 5e8d5ad607ba7b8c4f85364640afdeca826d84ab45d32b497c7dba48e91dfb3d) because write tools are denied unless allow-listed.

rootCause.description: verifyAllowed() only has deny-list gates (readOnly default false, disabledTools default []), so every write and delete tool is enabled unless an operator opts out. No least-privilege allow-list exists.
